jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and results-driven M&A professional with 5-7 years of relevant experience, ideally gained in corporate finance advisory, strategy consulting or corporate M&A. This role offers a unique opportunity to apply your expertise in deal execution, valuation, and strategic thinking to impactful transactions that help shape the future of Heraeus.

The following challenges await you:

- You advise Heraeus’ Senior Executives on inorganic growth opportunities for its Operating Companies and Business Areas, thereby making you an essential part of Group strategy.
- You lead and support M&A transactions (e.g. buy/sell-sides, investments, partnerships) across all phases – from origination to integration.
- You perform in-depth financial modelling, valuation, and due diligence assessments and are involved in the subsequent negotiation and structuring of these transactions.
- You collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to assess strategic fit and deal rationale.
- You identify and analyse new areas and investment opportunities that are of interest to Heraeus or its group companies.
- You prepare and deliver presentations on opportunities, transaction progress, and strategic recommendations to Senior Executives, and serve as subject matter expert on M&A topics.

- Very good English & German skills both written and spoken

jobs.description:
The following challenges await you:

- As Enterprise Architect (m/f/d) AI Governance & Architecture, you will shape, position and further develop the Enterprise Architecture discipline with a dedicated focus on Artificial Intelligence within the Heraeus Group.
- You will define and evolve enterprise-wide AI reference architectures, architecture principles, guardrails and decision frameworks to ensure that AI initiatives are scalable, secure, compliant and aligned with the overall business and IT strategy.
- In close collaboration within IT,  the AI & Digitalization Office and key stakeholders such as Information Security, Legal, Compliance, Data Protection and Risk Management, you will help establish a consistent and pragmatic approach to AI governance across the group.
- You will contribute to the further development of the AI governance process, ensuring that current and future regulatory requirements, internal policies and enterprise architecture standards are appropriately reflected in architectural decision-making.
- Furthermore, you will support the evaluation, classification and prioritization of AI-related initiatives and use cases from an enterprise architecture perspective, considering business value, architectural fit, risk, compliance, reusability and long-term portfolio impact.

- You will consult and advise IT, business and AI teams on architectural best practices for AI-enabled solutions, ensuring alignment with defined enterprise architecture standards, target architectures and governance guidelines.
- Last but not least, you will establish and maintain strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, business partners, architects and governance bodies to ensure close alignment between business ambitions, AI opportunities and enterprise-wide architectural integrity.

Your profile:

- Several years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, IT architecture, business architecture or technology strategy; experience in governance-related roles is beneficial.
- Good understanding of enterprise architecture methods, architecture governance, IT landscapes, cloud technologies, application architectures and digital transformation topics.
- Solid understanding of AI trends, AI-enabled business capabilities and the implications of AI for enterprise architecture, governance, risk and compliance - without the need to act as a deep technical AI/ML specialist.
- Experience in defining architecture principles, reference architectures, guardrails, standards or governance processes in complex organizational environments.
- Familiarity with regulatory, security, data protection and compliance considerations related to AI, digital technologies or data-driven solutions is an advantage.
- Ability to translate business needs, regulatory requirements and technology trends into pragmatic architectural guidance and decision criteria.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural and governance topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders in German and English.

- Cabin Safety Certification

- FAA Part 25
- Experience working with aircraft seat suppliers
- Strong understanding of aircraft cabin systems
- Fluent English

jobs.occupation: Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D (Leiter/in - Softwareentwicklung)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building high-performing engineering organizations and shaping the future of digital product delivery? Do you enjoy combining strong technical understanding with people leadership, operational excellence, and transformation? 

In KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA Einbeck, we are looking for a  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D to lead and further develop our digital engineering organization. As part of the R&D Digital Product & Technology Development leadership team you will drive the delivery of digital products, platforms, and services for R&D, while continuously improving engineering standards, delivery performance, quality, reliability, and productivity.  

You will play a key role in evolving our engineering setup into a more flexible, AI-enabled, and metric-driven organization that can respond dynamically to changing business priorities and accelerate innovation across KWS. 

Your Responsibilities 

As  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D, you will shape the future of digital product delivery at KWS by building a high-performing and adaptable engineering organization that enables innovation on a scale. 

You will: 

- Lead and further develop the engineering organization responsible for delivering digital products, platforms, and services that support our global R&D activities.
- Drive engineering excellence by creating an environment where teams can deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality solutions with speed and impact.
- Build a future-ready organization by advancing modern ways of working, strengthening engineering capabilities, and unlocking the potential of AI across the development lifecycle.
- Foster strong partnerships across business and technology functions while ensuring effective collaboration with external vendors and service partners.
- Inspire, coach, and empower leaders and teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, innovation, and inclusion. 

Your Profile 

You are an experienced technology leader (m/f/d) who enjoys developing people, shaping organizations, and turning ambitious ideas into business value. 

You bring: 

- Proven leadership experience in software engineering, digital product development, or technology-driven organizations.
- A track record successfully leading complex products, platforms, or transformation initiatives in dynamic environments.
- Strong understanding of modern engineering practices and the ability to translate strategic goals into effective execution.
- Experience driving organizational change and building high-performing teams through trust, empowerment, and collaboration.
- Curiosity for emerging technologies, including AI, and a passion for continuously improving how engineering teams work and deliver value.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with fluency in English. German is a plus. 

What You Can Expect 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape a strategically important engineering function at the interface of digital technology, R&D, and innovation. You will work in a global environment and contribute to strengthening the digital capabilities that support KWS’ future growth. 

You can expect: 

- A leadership role with global scope and high strategic relevance.  
- The opportunity to shape modern engineering standards, practices, and operating models  
- Highly motivated internal teams of software developers working in synthony with external teams
- A strong support to enable new technologies, like AI, and to develop future-ready digital capabilities
- Close collaboration with digital products, technology, R&D, and business stakeholders
- A working environment that values collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation 

Join Us 

If you are excited about leading engineering transformation, enabling high-performing teams, and shaping the future of digital product delivery in an innovative R&D environment, we look forward to receiving your application. 

**Grow your career with KWS and help us build the digital capabilities of tomorrow.**

LCE Europe is a German subsidiary of the Lianchuang Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. (LCE) which was established in 2006 and listed on the SME Board of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in December 2015 (stock code: 002036).

LCE focuses on the development of new optical and optoelectronic industries including optical lenses and image modules, touchscreen devices, etc., and invests and makes developments in electroacoustic and chip industries. The Group’s products are widely used in smart terminals, smart cars, smart homes, smart cities, etc.

For more than ten years, the Group has been continuously consolidating its industrial foundation, continuing to innovate and develop, and has successively established industrial bases in Jiangxi, Chongqing, Zhengzhou, Changzhou, Hefei, and other places as in Mexico and Vietnam.

https://www.lcetron.com

- Strong results- and self- driven skills
- Motivated in learning new technologies and products
- Willing to travel
- Business fluent in English and Chinese, other languages is a plus
